# Close the loop with raiser

`customer_support.pb.escalation_management.close_the_loop_with_raiser` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Tell the raising agent what happened after the transfer, including when the escalation was judged unnecessary.

Escalation judgement is learned only from feedback on past calls. An agent who never hears the outcome calibrates on how the transfer felt, which is the wrong signal, and typically converges on escalating less than they should.
